text:
zoe: opened PR to clarify batching_hint defaults and SDK examples: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/501

ken: quick note: SDK examples omit batching_hint when it matches runtime default to avoid copy-paste mistakes.

devin: runtime confirmation: Hosted + Private control plane default to 'auto'. Dedicated pools default to 'manual' unless adaptive batching is enabled on the pool.

zoe: thanks. CI preview currently shows examples with batching_hint: 'auto' which will confuse Dedicated customers. Plan: change examples to omit field, add a callout about env-dependent defaults, and add a short snippet showing how to force the value. Thoughts?

ken: yes, do that. Also add a one-liner in the SDK docs explaining the omission policy.

ci-bot: docs-preview: build started for PR #501. Preview: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/501

ci-bot: linkcheck: ERROR  found internal-only URL in migration guide.

zoe: fixed link to public spec and pushed. Also added ```js fences for code blocks.

ci-bot: preview updated. linkcheck: OK. accessibility: warning  code block missing language tag fixed in latest push.

docs-bot: PR #501 status: awaiting approvals (1/2). Requested reviewers: @ken @devin.

ken: LGTM, left one tiny wording nit about "adaptive batching" linking to Dedicated admin guide.

devin: LGTM for accuracy.

zoe: thanks all, requesting Tue merge slot. Removing blocker label.
